description: This Java class, RenderableFtlFormElementsBuilder, is responsible for creating renderable form elements for a web application, including tooltips, labels, display fields, input fields, hyperlinks, and container elements. It integrates with the OFBiz framework and uses various utility classes for encoding, URL building, and localization.

classes.name: RenderableFtlFormElementsBuilder
classes.description: A utility class for constructing renderable form elements in a web application, supporting various input types, labels, tooltips, hyperlinks, and container elements, with integration into the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: tooltip
methods.description: Creates a renderable tooltip element based on the provided form field.

methods.name: asterisks
methods.description: Creates a renderable indicator for required fields.

methods.name: displayField
methods.description: Creates a renderable display field element, supporting in-place editing and AJAX.

methods.name: textField
methods.description: Creates a renderable text input field with optional AJAX and validation.

methods.name: textArea
methods.description: Creates a renderable textarea input with support for visual editors.

methods.name: dateTime
methods.description: Creates a date/time input element, supporting dropdowns and masks.

methods.name: dateFind
methods.description: Creates a date find input element with localization and calendar popup.

methods.name: makeHyperlinkString
methods.description: Creates a hyperlink element based on a subHyperlink object.

methods.name: makeHyperlinkByType
methods.description: Creates a hyperlink element with specific link type, style, and parameters.

methods.name: hyperlinkMacroCall
methods.description: Generates a macro call for a hyperlink with detailed parameters.

methods.name: containerMacroCall
methods.description: Creates a container element macro call.

methods.name: fieldGroupOpen
methods.description: Creates an opening macro for a collapsible field group.

methods.name: fieldGroupClose
methods.description: Creates a closing macro for a field group.

methods.name: dropDownField
methods.description: Creates a dropdown select element with options and AJAX support.
